ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (37) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Устройство» (ustroystvo, 'arrangement') is kept as 'arrangement' throughout, since Tolstoy sets the arrangement of life against the arrangement of the soul (the website draft varied it with 'system'), and «начало» (nachalo) is 'source' ('the source of love'). The closing quotation, from 1 John 3:14–15, is given in Tolstoy's own wording («если любим», esli lyubim, 'if we love'), and the shift from «ты» (ty, 'you') to «я» (ya, 'I') in the passage on self-love is kept as printed.
